details.jobDescription:
For our client, an internationally renowned European retail and consumer goods brand, we are recruiting a Data & AI Engineering Lead to establish and lead their brand-new Data & AI delivery unit in Bucharest, Romania.

In this role, you will report directly to the GenAI & Agentic AI team in Germany and serve as the founding leader of the Romanian technology hub by combining disciplinary and professional leadership with technical depth, business acumen, and hands-on delivery. You will work as an integral part of an established international organization spanning Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Marketing Analytics, Customer Intelligence, and Data Warehousing, taking end-to-end ownership of strategic projects while scaling local capabilities.

Candidate Profile

  • Around 8 years of solid experience in leading technical teams, delivery teams, or engineering organizations;

  • Proven track record in building, developing, coaching, and mentoring a new team or organizational unit from the ground up;

  • Demonstrated experience in both disciplinary and professional people leadership;

  • Strong technical background across Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, and Platform Engineering;

  • Hands-on expertise with modern cloud platforms (particularly Google Cloud Platform), open-source technologies, streaming, and distributed data processing;

  • Strong software engineering foundation, including proficiency in Python, SQL, modern APIs, containerization, orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines;

  • In-depth experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG architectures, AI agents, and MCP server integrations (must-have);

  • Proven experience in production deployment, monitoring, security, and operational ownership of AI and data solutions integrated with business applications;

  • Solid business acumen: ability to connect technical decisions with customer value and tangible outcomes across functions like Marketing, Online, Customer Intelligence, and IT;

  • Experience delivering complex initiatives in agile or structured delivery environments, with comfort in taking ownership in ambiguous or evolving contexts;

  • A balance of strategic vision and a hands-on mindset, being willing to write code, review architectures, solve technical blockers, and guide the team directly;

  • Collaborative leadership style combined with decisiveness, accountability, and confidence in working across locations, cultures, and organizational boundaries;

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical business stakeholders;

  • German language proficiency is considered a plus, but is not mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establishing and growing the local Data & AI delivery unit, providing direct disciplinary and professional leadership to an initial team of 5 to 6 specialists;

  • Creating a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing engineering culture while mentoring team members to take independent ownership of deliverables;

  • Supporting end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, continuous professional development, and performance management for the local team;

  • Acting as the primary point of contact for technology, project execution, and people-related topics in Romania, closely coordinating with the international data organization;

  • Driving end-to-end delivery of Data Engineering, Generative AI, and Agentic AI projects from initial idea, requirements gathering, and architecture to production deployment;

  • Ensuring project delivery aligns with established quality standards, transparency, governance, and architectural frameworks;

  • Leading Proof-of-Concept (PoC) studies and applied research initiatives in close alignment with global teams;

  • Assuming full operational responsibility for production Data & AI systems, including monitoring, maintenance, incident response, platform security, and continuous improvements;

  • Actively shaping the technology landscape across modern data platforms, data warehousing, scalable platform services, APIs, data products, MCP server integrations, and intelligent business applications;

  • Maintaining hands-on involvement by reviewing system architectures, setting technical direction, coding, and solving operational challenges when needed;

  • Representing the unit at industry events, tech conferences, and recruiting fairs across Romania to actively position the client as an employer of choice in the Data & AI community.

Only eligible candidates will be contacted within a maximum of 3 weeks. All information will be treated as strictly confidential.
